# ForgeSworn Archipelago Apps

> ForgeSworn app manifests and runtime integrations for self-hosted Archipelago nodes.

## Documentation

- [App catalogue and integration](https://github.com/forgesworn/archipelago-apps/blob/main/README.md): Packaging scope, operator setup and release boundaries.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/archipelago-apps): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
